passed: At 1280px and 390px, the first Tab reaches a visible skip link; Enter transfers focus to main#main.
Full Tab traversal follows document order across header, content, FAQ or guide controls, and footer; no hidden panel receives focus and no positive tabindex exists.
All traversed interactive elements receive the visible 4px focus outline and remain at least partly within the viewport; no sticky overlay obscures focus.
Guide disclosure buttons support Enter and Space, update aria-expanded, and retain focus when expanded or collapsed.
The all-toggle supports Enter and Space, expands or collapses every panel, retains focus, and updates its label and status message.
Guide index links support Enter, reveal their target panel, and transfer focus to its disclosure button at both viewport widths.
Activating a same-step hash link after collapsing its panel reopens it and restores focus to its disclosure button.
Native introduction FAQ disclosures respond to both Enter and Space.
notes: Source review and keyboard automation used headless Chrome through Puppeteer; no real accounts were created or modified.
Screen-reader speech and operating-system keyboard settings were outside this keyboard specialist review.
